title: Satellite
definition: A satellite is a celestial body or an artificial object engineered to orbit a planet or star, serving specialized functions ranging from Earth observation and communication to scientific exploration and navigation.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for Science & Technology (Space Technology, ISRO milestones, orbital mechanics, remote sensing, space policy) in GS Paper III and international geopolitical security dimensions in GS Paper II.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts, orbital mechanics, and classifications of satellites.
Evaluate institutional frameworks like IN-SPACe, NewSpace India Limited (NSIL), and the Indian Space Policy.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions on orbits and satellite types.
